summary: Dyne Therapeutics, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a $300M common stock offering. The public offering price is yet to be determined, but the last sale was $23.45 per share. Underwriters include Morgan Stanley, Jefferies, Evercore ISI, LifeSci Capital, and Raymond James, with a 30-day option for $45M additional shares. This is an ordinary equity follow-on offering, not a special situation. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No special-situations elements present; filing is a routine capital raise via underwritten public offering.
